name: Cultivate Food Rescue
address: 1400 W Western Ave, South Bend, IN
openStatus: Open for scheduled drop-off until 8 PM
description: Featured local partner coordinating safe surplus handoff from gameday hosts to neighborhood meal programs.
policyNotes: Prepared items should be held above 140F or below 41F before drop-off.
Label each pan with item name and approximate prep time.
No partially served trays from guest-facing tables.
dropoffInstructions: Use the west loading entry and mention TLAC host donation check-in at the desk.

name: St. Vincent Community Kitchen
address: 402 W Washington St, South Bend, IN
description: Community kitchen partner offering same-evening redistribution for safely handled tailgate trays.
policyNotes: Call ahead for large pan donations over 20 servings.
Use covered disposable containers for quick intake.
dropoffInstructions: Drop-off table is beside the north entrance volunteer check station.

name: River Bend Family Pantry
description: Pantry partner focused on shelf-stable and produce donations after game weekends.
policyNotes: Prepared hot foods are not accepted at this location.
Sealed pantry boxes and produce only.
dropoffInstructions: Use the side pantry door with labeled boxes ready for sorting.

name: Howard Park Community Fridge
address: S Saint Joseph St, South Bend, IN
description: Neighborhood fridge network with rapid handoff for sealed ready-to-share items.
policyNotes: Each container must include date and ingredients.
Use sealed compostable clamshells for single servings.
hours: Volunteer check windows: 8:00 AM and 6:00 PM
dropoffInstructions: Place labeled meals on the top shelf and text the volunteer line after drop-off.
